provenance.applicabilityNote: Not version-gated at runtime. CombatFight exposes no client-build key, and gameVersion/logVersion are Warcraft Logs parser keys, not the World of Warcraft client build — comparing either against 12.1.0.69587 would be a gate that always passes while appearing rigorous. The build is recorded for traceability; a client build moving is a regeneration trigger for a human, not a runtime condition.
